verdict.rationale: Synctera documents a real-time Internal Transfer API and a Webhook API that pushes updates instead of requiring polling, which supports event-driven architecture, but the evidence never explicitly confirms balance reads reflect holds/pending activity or that webhooks fire for every transaction state change. Missing for 10: documentation on balance API reflecting holds/pending transactions, explicit list/coverage of webhook events per transaction lifecycle state, and independent/hands-on confirmation of webhook completeness.
